verdict.rationale: BigQuery's docs list predefined IAM roles and permissions that apply to datasets, tables, views, and routines, so role-based access at the table level is evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows access control reaching columns or rows, or any masking policy. Missing for 10: column-level access control, row-level security/access policies, dynamic data masking policies, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-team governance.
